title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
subtitle: Connect AI coding agents and LLMs directly to Civify's AI resume parsing, tailoring, ATS scoring, and job tracking platform.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about integrating Civify with AI agents, Cursor, and Claude Desktop.

q1.question: What is the Civify MCP server?
q1.answer: The Civify MCP server connects agents to resume parsing, tailoring, ATS scoring, PII masking, PDF export and application tracking. Hosted OAuth provides 13 tools; local/legacy sessions include five additional authentication helpers.

q2.question: How do I connect ChatGPT or Claude?
q2.answer: Add https://mcp.civify.cv/mcp in the client’s connector settings and connect with OAuth. Sign in to Civify in the browser and approve access. No API key or local npm installation is needed for hosted connections.

q3.question: Does Civify MCP support Arabic resumes, RTL layouts, and Arabic OCR?
q3.answer: Yes! Civify is natively bilingual. The MCP server fully parses Arabic resume documents (PDF, DOCX, scanned images via Arabic OCR) and can generate RTL-formatted tailored resumes with specialized typography and localized keyword optimization for Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and GCC job markets.

q4.question: How do I authenticate?
q4.answer: Public onboarding, pricing, job scraping and PDF rendering require no account. Private tools use OAuth account linking in the browser. Local stdio can use CIVIFY_API_KEY in trusted client settings. Do not share credentials in chat.

q5.question: Which tools are available?
q5.answer: Start with civify_get_started. Hosted tools cover account balance, pricing, purchase initiation, entitlements, job scraping, parsing, tailoring, ATS scoring, masking, PDF generation and application creation/listing.

q6.question: Can every job URL be scraped?
q6.answer: Public job pages may be supported, but login walls, anti-bot checks and site changes can prevent scraping. Supply the job description text when the URL cannot be read.

q7.question: How do I check pricing?
q7.answer: Call civify_get_pay_per_cv_pricing for current offers. Confirm the currency and amount at checkout; regional detection can depend on gateway network location. Do not rely on a hardcoded price in a prompt.

q8.question: What is the difference between local stdio and hosted HTTP?
q8.answer: Local npx runs the server on your machine and can use local files. Hosted HTTP uses /mcp and OAuth, accepts attachments/URLs/text/base64, and returns temporary PDF links. Legacy SSE remains at /sse for older clients.

regional.title: Global & MENA Regional Capabilities
regional.bilingualDesc: Full support for English and Arabic CVs, including Arabic OCR for scanned documents and RTL template rendering.
regional.pricingDesc: Automatic currency routing: USD for international users, and localized EGP rates with mobile wallet support for MENA.
regional.privacyDesc: Built-in PII redaction (civify_mask_pii) creates anonymized resumes to eliminate bias and protect candidate privacy.

workflow.title: From CV attachment to downloadable result
workflow.subtitle: Hosted OAuth exposes 13 tools. Local stdio retains 18 tools, including legacy authentication helpers.
workflow.connect: Add this URL in ChatGPT or Claude connector settings, select OAuth, and connect your account:
workflow.auth: Sign in to Civify in the browser using your existing account, or create an account first. Review the requesting app and permissions, then choose Allow and connect. No API key is needed. Never paste passwords or credentials into chat.
workflow.attach: Attach your CV. ChatGPT can supply a native file input where supported. Other clients can send an actual HTTPS download URL or the complete text they read from your attachment.
workflow.task: Parsing is optional: the agent can send structured CV data directly. Tailoring returns a PDF by default. If export fails, retry only PDF generation with the returned tailored CV. AI operations may use credits.
workflow.download: Open the generated PDF download link within 15 minutes. Links also expire on server restart; anyone with the link can access the file.
workflow.fallback: Attachment access depends on the client. If it cannot read or forward a file, provide readable CV text or a supported attachment. Never invent file URLs, base64, or server paths. Files are limited to 12 MiB.
workflow.local: For local stdio, configure CIVIFY_API_KEY securely in the client environment. Hosted connectors run remotely and cannot read local sandbox paths.
